verdict.rationale: DeepInfra explicitly documents that developers can point the official OpenAI SDK (and presumably any OpenAI-compatible client library) directly at its API by changing only base_url, api_key, and model, requiring no code changes — a well-documented drop-in SDK compatibility path (deepinfra-docs-1, deepinfra-docs-14, deepinfra-docs-15, deepinfra-docs-25, deepinfra-docs-30). This covers chat completions, tool calling, and reasoning params through that same SDK interface (deepinfra-docs-35, deepinfra-docs-17). Missing for 10: an independently verified/hands-on SDK integration example, and evidence of a dedicated DeepInfra-branded SDK/OpenAPI spec (probe results show llms.txt/docs.md/openapi.json all 404).
